title: GAN-ETAN (FiETAN)
summary: A research implementation of the Extended Tree Augmented Naive Classifier (ETAN) combined with a GAN-based data generator to synthesize training data and improve classification performance across six real-world datasets. The repository vendors the ctgan package in-tree and imports CTGAN directly (from ctgan.synthesizers.ctgan import CTGAN) to generate the synthetic training data used by the method.
